sources.title: MOSS Image - SFT | MOSS Image Checkpoint | Civitai
sources.snippet: MOSS Image is a 5B parameter text-to-image DiT from the OpenMOSS team, built for accurate in-image text, layout control and long prompts. It pairs a Qwen3.5 9B text encoder with the FLUX.2 VAE, accepts prompts of up to 4K tokens in natural language, booru-style tags or a JSON layout, and renders from 512px up to 2K at any aspect ratio.
